research.voidheart.armillary.desc: Below the world lie others that broke long ago. Three rings turning on each other can feel their way down to them, bound with the gold of [[shatter_forge]].
research.voidheart.daedalus.desc: Under every broken world lies one that never ends, corridor stacked on corridor. Its makers drew on the void until it drew on them. Roots grown by [[armillary]] can reach down that far, and open a way onto one of its bridges.
research.voidheart.hunger_beneath.desc: Below the floor of the void something is chewing. It has been chewing since before worlds stood, and it has noticed you listening.
research.voidheart.litany_of_teeth.desc: Count them and they are more. Every world it ate left it one more tooth, and every tooth still remembers the taste.
research.voidheart.gullet.desc: Past the [[litany_of_teeth]] the throat goes down without end, and far down it something looks back up.
research.voidheart.maw.desc: First and greatest of what waits in the void. It does not hate and it does not want. It only hungers, and you have already been tasted.
research.voidheart.sealed_mind.desc: Thread pulled through flesh that was never meant to close, stitch by stitch, until it can no longer speak into your thoughts. It still pushes against the seams.

voidheart.page.rubrum_construct_core: Where void energy is kept. Raise {{rubrum_construct_frame}}s along the edges of a cube 3 or 5 blocks wide and set the core in its middle. Rubrum bundles in its sockets decide how much it holds, and azurium bundles how fast it fills and gives back. Inside the field of an {{azurium_pylon}} it takes what machines leave over and gives it back when they need more. It keeps its charge when broken. Held above 90% for a long while, it grows a new small rubrum bundle.
voidheart.page.rubrum_construct_frame: The edges of a {{rubrum_construct_core}}'s cube. The open faces between them are its sockets:  the construct with a rubrum or azurium bundle to set it in the free socket nearest your hand, and sneak and  with an empty hand to take the nearest one out.

voidheart.page.cell_socket: Holds a {{rubrum_cell}}. Inside the field of an {{azurium_pylon}} it empties the cell into the field, up to 64 VE a tick, or fills it from the field while it has a redstone signal.

voidheart.page.ley_stone: Bends ley off a line toward you. A standing stone within 32 blocks of a ley line taps it, and each stone within 32 blocks of a connected one carries the spur on. Machines within 8 blocks of a connected stone draw on the line. Everything drawing on one line shares its flow, and what is upstream is served first. The flow rises and falls with the moon.
voidheart.page.ley_ward: Near a connected {{ley_stone}}, it slows how fast corruption rises in anyone within 16 blocks. It never lowers what is already there. It holds the air less well on a weak supply, on a tainted line, or in the seep of the void.

research.voidheart.void_flesh.desc: What the altar will take, and what it gives back.
research.voidheart.archive_expansion.des: Voidstone can be taught to remember. Columns of it hold what the tablet cannot.
research.voidheart.patient_study.desc: The repository learns to listen while nobody is there.
research.voidheart.shatter_forge.desc: Matter can be thrown through the Void and come back changed.
research.voidheart.quicksilver_rite.desc: What never stays still can carry a body past what would stop it. Drawn off in the vessels of [[tria_prima]].
research.voidheart.sulfur_rite.desc: What burns can be taught to burn only where it is laid. Brewed in the vessels of [[tria_prima]].
research.voidheart.kindred_oils.desc: A wound remembers what made it. Laid with the right oil, it remembers wrong. Brewed in the vessels of [[tria_prima]], like [[sulfur_rite]].
research.voidheart.salt_rite.desc: What remains can be made to hold a line. Drawn from the silt of the trench, as [[tria_prima]] teaches.
research.voidheart.tria_prima.desc: Sulfur burns, quicksilver flees, salt remains. What [[shatter_forge]] does to matter, a slower fire can do to what is made of it.
research.voidheart.refinement.desc: A shard set beside a brew in a crucible it does not need lends it what it holds: Azurium makes the brew stronger, Rubrum makes it last ((rubrum_percent))% longer, and one of each may share a brew. Memoriam beside a brew of Insight makes it remember: a hostile creature once seen stays outlined through stone for ((memory_seconds)) seconds after it slips from sight. A flask of sin metal set in place of the glass bottle changes the brew again, and asks something back. Learned in the vessels of [[tria_prima]].
research.voidheart.portal_flexion.desc: Two places can be folded onto each other, as the rings of [[armillary]] fold the world onto broken ones.
research.voidheart.void_husbandry.desc: Small, obedient things the altar can grow.
research.voidheart.far_sight.desc: An eye needs no body to look through.
research.voidheart.vast_archive.desc: Every column is larger on the inside than it first let on.
research.voidheart.steady_mind.desc: The repository keeps a thought going long after you stopped feeding it.
research.voidheart.shoulder_eye.desc: An eye that follows you of its own will, opened by [[far_sight]].
research.voidheart.wraith_veil.desc: The ink a wraith bleeds still remembers stone as no wall at all. Woven as [[permeable_barrier]] is, it carries its bearer through.
research.voidheart.beholder.desc: A table can look through other eyes than its own, once [[far_sight]] has shown it how.
research.voidheart.permeable_barrier.des: A wall the void can be taught to open for some and close to the rest, woven at the altar.
research.voidheart.boundless_archive.des: The columns stop pretending they have an edge.
research.voidheart.outside_thought.desc: Something else is thinking in the repository now. It shares.
research.voidheart.cogitation.desc: A mind can be kept thinking with nobody left around it, and taught to think for the repository.
research.voidheart.weaving.desc: Loose void can be woven into order. Ordered thought costs less to refine.
research.voidheart.meat_proxy.desc: A kept mind can be grown past its cage, until it is large enough to suffer in your place.
research.voidheart.concord.desc: Kept minds left near one another learn each other's thoughts, and think them faster together.
research.voidheart.void_vein.desc: The heart was only the first thing given. Let the void run in the blood too.
research.voidheart.void_marrow.desc: What the blood carries, the bones can keep. Few go this far and stay whole.
research.voidheart.avenging_reach.desc: The void does not forgive a blow. Let it grow arms in you that answer every one.
research.voidheart.klein_star.desc: What a [[contravoid_reactor]] does at its center can be done in the open air, at the end of a staff, for an instant, if nothing is asked to contain it.
research.voidheart.void_energy.desc: The void does not stay where it is poured. Azurium lets it run through as if it were not there, rubrum holds it and will not give it back, and a maw fed with essence spits more of it out than it swallowed. The rings of [[armillary]], the furnace of [[tria_prima]] and the folds of [[portal_flexion]] all drink from it.
research.voidheart.ley_sense.desc: What [[far_sight]] only showed can be led. The world runs with currents older than any anchor, and a stone raised beside a line bends a little of one toward you. It cannot be kept, only used as it comes: it steadies the air against the void, quickens what grows, and lends [[beholder]] its sight.
research.voidheart.ley_conversion.desc: A stake of azurium driven into a line lets the void run through the land as it runs through the crystal, and the ley comes out the other side as [[void_energy]]. Bled lightly, the land heals faster than it is taken from. Bled deeply, it bruises, the bruise runs downstream, and in it gathers what neither side wants: Contravoid.
research.voidheart.void_fissure.desc: Why lead the void anywhere, when it can be let in? A crack opened in the ground bleeds its current where you stand, more the wider it is torn. What seeps out with it thins every ward around, hastens corruption and lets small things through. Only Contravoid closes it again.
research.voidheart.contravoid_reactor.de: Contravoid is what the void is not. Fed against an essence of the void, each from its own side, the two unmake each other at the center, and what is left is enough to run everything you have built. Once lit it must be fed. Starved or broken open while it burns, it fails inward and leaves a wound. Shut down, it only sleeps.
research.voidheart.deep_siphon.desc: The makers of [[daedalus]] drew on the void until it drew on them, and their current still runs under its bridges. A siphon set on one, while the rings of [[armillary]] hold the way open, sends it back up to whatever stands around them.

voidheart.page.cogitant: Each one within ((column_radius)) blocks of your repository gathers ((cogitant_rate)) more knowledge per second for it, up to ((cogitant_limit)). You have ((cogitant_count)) thinking. Those beyond that sit idle.
voidheart.page.void_loom: One near your repository makes the price of insights grow a quarter slower, and the ones already crafted count as woven too. A second one only weaves for nobody.
voidheart.page.meat_proxy: Grown from a {{cogitant}}. Near your repository it bears ((proxy_strain)) strain of a deep research for you, wearing only while that strain is needed. It gives out once spent, and keeps what is left of it when broken. It also thinks, making ((proxy_insights)) insights an hour. Up to ((proxy_limit)) work for a repository at a time. You have ((proxy_count)).
voidheart.page.void_vein: Eat it once your heart is in the void. You then bear 25 strain instead of 10. Away from the void hunger gnaws faster, in it barely at all.
voidheart.page.void_marrow: Eat it once the {{void_vein}} runs in you. You then bear 45 strain. Away from the void wounds close slower, in it faster.
voidheart.page.avenging_reach_1: Eat it to grow a void arm. When something within 3 blocks hurts you, the arm lashes out, strikes it as hard as an iron sword and throws it back, then takes 3 seconds to recharge. Up to four arms can grow, each from its own, dearer graft.
voidheart.page.avenging_reach_2: Eat it once {{avenging_reach_1}} has grown its arm. A second arm answers the next blow while the first recharges.
voidheart.page.avenging_reach_3: Eat it once {{avenging_reach_2}} has grown its arm. A third arm answers yet another blow while the others recharge.
voidheart.page.avenging_reach_4: Eat it once {{avenging_reach_3}} has grown its arm. The fourth and last arm: four blows in a row are answered before the first arm is ready again.

voidheart.knowledge.not_owner: This repository answers to someone else
voidheart.jade.spike.off_lattice: Dry: not driven into a ley line or node
voidheart.jade.spike.setting: Set to %s%% of a flow of %s ley
voidheart.page.azurium_spike: Driven into a ley line or node, it bleeds the ley into void energy for the field of an {{azurium_pylon}} around it: 8 VE a tick for each ley, up to 12 ley. Use it with an empty hand to bleed a larger share of the flow, 25, 50, 75 or all of it, and sneak to bleed less. It only bleeds what the field takes. A quarter of the flow is less than the land heals. More bruises the node, the bruise runs downstream, and the node's flow weakens. From a bruised node comes Contravoid, more the deeper the bruise, gathered by a Ravenous Collector attuned with an azurium shard.
voidheart.research.full: The repository is full. More is lost.
voidheart.research.unread_desc: Its shape is there. Its meaning is not.
voidheart.research.whisper.begin: A revealed research waits to begin.
voidheart.research.whisper.starving: The research starves. Feed the repository.
voidheart.research.craft.capped: Costs %s, more than the repository holds
voidheart.research.feed_hint: Use something strange on the repository.
voidheart.research.whisper.refine: Enough has gathered to craft an insight.
voidheart.research.card.title: Knowledge
voidheart.research.cogitant_rate: Each Cogitant gathers +%s knowledge per second
voidheart.research.strain_proxies: Strain %s, you bear %s and your proxies %s
voidheart.research.whisper.strained: The research weighs too much. Go deeper into the void, or let a proxy bear it.
voidheart.scene.void_altar.altar: Set the Void Altar down where there is room around it.
voidheart.scene.void_altar.pillars: Eight Void Pillars stand around it on the same level: two on each side, three blocks out.
voidheart.scene.void_altar.offerings: Lay what the rite asks for on the pillars. Here, six obsidian shards and two ender shards.
voidheart.scene.void_altar.catalyst: The last ingredient goes on the altar, and begins the rite.  again to take it back and stop.
voidheart.scene.void_altar.rite: The altar warms, then draws the offerings in one by one. Some rites also drink experience from Experience Skulls close by.
voidheart.scene.void_altar.result: What was made floats where the ingredient was.  the altar to take it.
voidheart.scene.shatter_forge.forge: The Shatter Forge stands at the head of the track.
voidheart.scene.shatter_forge.preview: With an empty hand, the forge shows ghosts of what is missing. Again to lengthen the track, sneaking to shorten it.
voidheart.scene.shatter_forge.conduits: Void Conduits run one level below the forge: a row of five under each monolith pair, and two between rows.
voidheart.scene.shatter_forge.monoliths: A Monolith three blocks tall rises at each end of a row. This recipe takes three pairs, the forge's own included.
voidheart.scene.shatter_forge.source: A Void Pillar closes the track, one block past the last pair.
voidheart.scene.shatter_forge.craft: Lay what is to be changed on the pillar. If the forge knows it, the beam forms by itself and carries it through.
voidheart.scene.shatter_forge.result: The forge holds what came back.  it to take it. It will not start again until you do.
voidheart.scene.athanor.alembic: An Alembic goes on top of it. No brew starts without one.
voidheart.scene.athanor.crucibles: Crucibles stand against its sides, up to four, in any order. Each holds one reagent.
voidheart.scene.athanor.intake: Brews that need aspects draw them through an Aspect Intake under the athanor. Ravenous Relays link to it, and it takes only what the brew still lacks.
voidheart.scene.athanor.athanor: The Athanor stands on it, the furnace every brew happens in.
voidheart.scene.athanor.base:  the athanor with the base of the brew, often a glass bottle.  again to take it back.
voidheart.scene.athanor.reagents:  each crucible with one reagent. Here, sulfur and quicksilver for a searing oil.
voidheart.scene.athanor.brew: Once a brew you know matches and its aspects are gathered, the athanor lights by itself. Take anything away and it stops.
voidheart.scene.athanor.result: The reagents are spent and the brew waits in the mouth.  the athanor to take it.
voidheart.scene.armillary.core: The Armillary Core sits at the heart of its base.
voidheart.scene.armillary.preview:  the core while its base is incomplete to see what it still lacks.
voidheart.scene.armillary.sides: Cut ravenous gold goes against each of its four sides.
voidheart.scene.armillary.corners: Chiseled voidstone fills the four corners.
voidheart.scene.armillary.rings: Once the base is whole it settles into a dais and three rings rise over it. Keep the three layers above the base free, or they will not turn.
voidheart.scene.armillary.power: Searching and opening draw void energy from the field of an Azurium Pylon. Without it, the search waits.
voidheart.scene.armillary.chart:  the core to open its chart. Bubbles surface on it every few minutes. Choose one and the rings turn fast while roots search for a path, longer the deeper it lies.
voidheart.scene.armillary.open: Once a path holds and its void energy is gathered, open it with void pearls from your inventory, more for deeper bubbles. A portal tears open between the rings.
voidheart.scene.armillary.cross:  the portal to cross. A rift where you arrive leads back here for as long as the connection holds.
voidheart.scene.armillary.decay: A connection lasts half an hour or more. Warnings come as it weakens and the rings falter, and when it gives way everyone inside is thrown back here.
voidheart.scene.void_grid.pylon: An Azurium Pylon carries void energy through the air. Bare, it does nothing.
voidheart.scene.void_grid.bundle: Set an azurium bundle on top of it. It now holds a field around the bundle, and machines inside draw from it with no wiring. A small bundle reaches 6 blocks.
voidheart.scene.void_grid.sizes: A medium bundle reaches 10 blocks and a large one 16. A larger bundle also passes more: 80, 128 or 192 VE a tick.
voidheart.scene.void_grid.arc: Pylons whose fields reach each other arc when nothing stands between their bundles. They become one grid, and energy passes down the chain without loss.
voidheart.scene.void_grid.engine: A Ravenous Engine burns essence into void energy for the field it stands in. Ravenous Relays within 8 blocks link to it by themselves, and carry what an attuned Ravenous Collector gathers.
voidheart.scene.void_grid.construct: Void energy is kept in a Rubrum Construct. Raise twenty Construct Frames along the edges of a cube 3 blocks wide, then  a frame with the core to set it in the middle.
voidheart.scene.void_grid.sockets: Its open faces are sockets.  the construct with a rubrum bundle to hold more, or an azurium bundle to fill and give back faster. Sneak and  with an empty hand to take one out.
voidheart.scene.contravoid_reactor.core: The Contravoid Reactor Core stands one block off the ground, so that its shell can close under it.
voidheart.scene.contravoid_reactor.shell: Close it in a cube of Reactor Containment 3 blocks wide. Leave the middle of two opposite sides open.
voidheart.scene.contravoid_reactor.intak: A Reactor Intake goes in each of the two. Once the shell is whole, the middle of every other side opens a slit.
voidheart.scene.contravoid_reactor.feed: Ravenous Relays feed the intakes: Contravoid at one end, from a collector attuned with an azurium shard, and Stillness, Fiery or Suffering essence at the other.
voidheart.scene.contravoid_reactor.light:  it with an empty hand to light it. Lighting draws 200,000 VE from the pylon field it stands in, so have that much stored first.
voidheart.scene.contravoid_reactor.lit: Lit, it gives up to 400 VE a tick on Fiery. If an intake runs dry or the shell is broken, it warns for 45 seconds, then fails inward. A redstone signal shuts it down safely.
voidheart.scene.azurium_spike.line: Find a ley line or node inside the field of an Azurium Pylon.
voidheart.scene.azurium_spike.spike: Drive the Azurium Spike into it. It bleeds a quarter of the flow into void energy for the field, 8 VE a tick for each ley.
voidheart.scene.azurium_spike.share:  it with an empty hand to bleed a larger share: half, three quarters, then all of it. Sneak and  to bleed less. It only bleeds what the field takes.
voidheart.scene.azurium_spike.contravoid: A quarter is less than the land heals. More bruises the node, and its flow weakens. A bruised node gives Contravoid to Ravenous Collectors within 8 blocks attuned with an azurium shard.
voidheart.scene.void_fissure.seed: Set a Fissure Seed on firm ground inside the field of an Azurium Pylon. The crack it tears bleeds void energy into the field.
voidheart.scene.void_fissure.widen: Press an azurium bundle into the crack to tear it wider: a small one twice, then a medium, then a large. Each is spent, and each raises what the crack gives.
voidheart.scene.void_fissure.seep: What seeps out spreads a block a minute, as far as 32 blocks at its widest. Inside it wards weaken, corruption creeps up on you and weak void creatures come through.
voidheart.scene.void_fissure.close: Nothing breaks it. Only Contravoid brought by Ravenous Relays closes it again, 2,000 for each width it was torn to.
voidheart.scene.ley_stone.line: A ley line runs through the land. It cannot be moved, but a little of it can be led away.
voidheart.scene.ley_stone.tap: A Standing Stone within 32 blocks of the line taps it, and a spur of ley bends toward the stone.
voidheart.scene.ley_stone.chain: Each stone within 32 blocks of a connected one carries the spur on.
voidheart.scene.ley_stone.supply: Machines within 8 blocks of a connected stone draw on the line. All of them share its flow, those upstream first, and it rises and falls with the moon.
voidheart.scene.ley_stone.ward: A Ley Ward near a connected stone slows how fast corruption rises in anyone within 16 blocks.
voidheart.scene.ley_stone.grower: A Ley Grower near a connected stone makes crops and saplings in a 9 by 9 square around it grow up to twice as fast.
voidheart.scene.portal.frame: Raise a frame of Voidstone Bricks around an opening, standing or lying flat. Its corners may be left out.
voidheart.scene.portal.form:  a brick of the frame with a Portal Core. The frame takes shape, and the core remembers it.
voidheart.scene.portal.second: Raise a second frame of the same shape. One of the two must stand in your Void Pocket and the other outside it.
voidheart.scene.portal.link:  the second frame with the same core. Both light, the way opens between them, and the core is spent.
voidheart.scene.portal.hold: An open way draws 4 VE a tick from the field of an Azurium Pylon on either side. Starved, it goes dark until it is fed again.
voidheart.scene.permeable_barrier.wall: The Barrier Weaver closes an opening with a ward that lets some through and stops others.
voidheart.scene.permeable_barrier.first:  a block with it. The space against the side you touched is the first corner.
voidheart.scene.permeable_barrier.second:  another block in line with the first, or a point in the air. A barrier is woven across the rectangle between them.
voidheart.scene.permeable_barrier.look:  the barrier to choose who it opens for and the block it looks like when closed. It wakes once a look is chosen.
voidheart.page.locked: How it is made comes with %s.
voidheart.page.made.forge_any: On the forge's pillar, one of
voidheart.page.made.crafting_any: In a crafting grid, in any order
voidheart.page.void_altar: Where rites are held. It needs eight Void Pillars around it, which hold the offerings a rite asks for, before it will take the ingredient that starts one. The greatest of its works, the {{shatter_forge}}, comes from [[shatter_forge]].
voidheart.page.void_amalgam: Eat it while you have no Void Pocket: it hurts, and leaves a {{void_heart}} bearing your name in your hand.
voidheart.page.void_heart: Your heart, made in eating a {{void_amalgam}}. Offered on a {{void_altar}}, it opens your Void Pocket, and three {{void_pearl}}s come back to you.
voidheart.page.void_pearl: Eat it to go to your Void Pocket, a few seconds later. You need a pocket first, which a {{void_heart}} opens. Both come from [[void_flesh]].
voidheart.page.eye_bottle: Place it, then  it to go to the Void Pocket of whoever placed it.
voidheart.page.void_lamp: A light that answers to the hand:  to turn it on or off.
voidheart.page.knowledge_column: Each one within ((column_radius)) blocks of your repository, in any direction, holds ((column_capacity)) knowledge for it. Four fit in a block space, and they stack. You have ((column_count)) linked, adding ((column_total)). [[vast_archive]] and [[boundless_archive]] deepen every column you have.
voidheart.page.voidstone: Stone changed by the Void, and where its building blocks begin. Stonecutters and crafting turn it into bricks, tiles and pillars.
voidheart.page.shatter_forge: Throws an item through the Void and catches what comes back. It needs a track of {{void_conduit}}s and {{void_monolith}}s, and a Void Pillar to hold what is to be changed.
voidheart.page.void_monolith: The columns of a {{shatter_forge}}. Three blocks stacked on each end of a conduit row make a pair, and stronger recipes need more pairs.
voidheart.page.athanor: A furnace of seething steel that brews slowly. Set an {{alembic}} on it and the base of a brew inside it, then put one reagent in each {{crucible}} against its sides. Brews that need aspects draw them through an {{aspect_intake}} below it.
voidheart.page.searing_oil: Brewed in an {{athanor}}.  it onto a sword, axe, spear, mace or trident in your inventory to coat it for ((searing_charges)) hits. A coated hit sets its target alight and counts as fire to what adapts to its wounds, whatever the blade. A new coat replaces the old one. Any oil also coats ((arrows_per_flask)) arrows, and each oiled arrow carries it for one hit.
voidheart.page.concussive_oil: Brewed in an {{athanor}}.  it onto a weapon in your inventory to coat it for ((concussive_charges)) hits. A coated hit throws its target further back, breaks off a Fallen Bishop's lance while it charges, and counts as a blunt blow to what adapts to its wounds.
voidheart.page.arcane_oil: Brewed in an {{athanor}}.  it onto a weapon in your inventory to coat it for ((arcane_charges)) hits. A coated hit strips one blessing from its target, such as strength or regeneration, and counts as magic to what adapts to its wounds.
voidheart.page.kernacian_oil: Brewed in an {{athanor}} around a Kernacian Core.  it onto a weapon in your inventory to coat it for ((kernacian_charges)) hits. A coated hit counts as a wound no Dragoon has learned, and strikes ((construct_percent))% harder at the Legionary, the Centurion and the Malignant Boulder.
voidheart.page.arrogant_iron_flask: Set in an {{athanor}} in place of a glass bottle, it makes a drink one level stronger. Drinking it drives out every other brew you have taken. Holds drinks only.
voidheart.page.ravenous_gold_flask: Set in an {{athanor}} in place of a glass bottle, it makes a drink last twice as long, and leaves you hungry for as long. Holds drinks only.
voidheart.page.seething_steel_flask: Set in an {{athanor}} in place of a glass bottle, it gives an oil half again as many hits, but each coated blow wears the weapon twice as fast. Holds oils only.
voidheart.page.covetous_copper_flask: Set in an {{athanor}} in place of a glass bottle, it yields two of what is brewed, each lasting ((copper_percent))% as long. Holds drinks and oils.
voidheart.page.listless_lead_flask: Set in an {{athanor}} in place of a glass bottle, it makes a drink last three times as long, and slows you for as long. Holds drinks only.
voidheart.page.salt: Drawn from abyssal silt in the {{shatter_forge}}.  it on the floor to lay a ward over ((salt_cells)) blocks, or on a ward to widen it all around, ((salt_cells)) blocks to each salt, up to ((salt_size)) across. What walks through walls cannot cross it or come out beside it, the Fallen burn on it and wear it away, barnacles will not settle on it, crabs drag through it and ghouls balk at its edge. Water washes it off.
voidheart.page.ember_draught: Brewed in an {{athanor}}. For ((ember_minutes)) minutes, the void fire of what was built to rule a battlefield bites half as deep. It still sets you alight, and no common fire ward stops it.
voidheart.page.stillwater: Brewed in an {{athanor}}. For ((stillwater_minutes)) minutes, the jets of the trench's smokers burn only a quarter as much.
voidheart.page.bulwark_elixir: Brewed in an {{athanor}}. For ((bulwark_seconds)) seconds, ((bulwark_health)) health stands in front of yours, enough to take a blow that cares for no armor and still be standing.
voidheart.page.insight_elixir: Brewed in an {{athanor}}. For ((insight_minutes)) minutes, what walks through walls shows through them, a bishop's crook gathers light before it casts, and what adapts to its wounds lets you read how far it has.
voidheart.page.clarity_draught: Brewed in an {{athanor}}. For ((clarity_minutes)) minutes, the haze beyond the Void thins around you and lets you see much farther, though never all the way.
voidheart.page.alembic: The still head of an {{athanor}}. No brew starts without it.
voidheart.page.crucible: Holds one reagent against the side of an {{athanor}}. Up to four fit around it, in any order.
voidheart.page.aspect_intake: Set under an {{athanor}}, Ravenous Relays link to it. It takes only what the brew above still lacks, from collectors and from the storages the relays reach.
voidheart.page.portal_core: Forms a portal when used on a frame of Void Bricks, then link it by hitting a second portal. One side must stand in your Void Pocket and the other outside. Reset it in a crafting grid.
voidheart.page.experience_skull: Keeps experience:  to give it some, sneak and  to take it back. It keeps what it holds when broken, and rites nearby drink from it.
voidheart.page.inventory_inserter: Moves one item each second between inventories, and can take from and give to Void Pillars.
voidheart.page.void_conduit: Carries a {{shatter_forge}}'s track, one level below the forge: a row of five under each {{void_monolith}} pair, and two between rows.
voidheart.page.oculus_table: Projects the land around it as a hologram above the table, with floating controls to zoom, follow a player, and show ley lines or the hollows inside the land.
voidheart.page.permeable_barrier_item:  a block, then another in line with it or a point in the air, to weave a barrier across the rectangle between them.  the barrier to choose who it opens for and how it looks when closed.
voidheart.page.shoulder_eye: Use it to bind it to you. It perches on your shoulder and burns those who hunt or hurt you. Sneak with an empty hand on it to take it back.
voidheart.page.wraith_veil:  a wall, floor or ceiling up to 10 blocks thick to stain it black and open a tunnel of shadow through it. Walk through, or climb up and down as on a ladder, and see what lives in the stone around you. After a few seconds the tunnel collapses and pushes you out of the nearer end. Holding it shows a faint mark where it can open, and none where fluid, bedrock or a pocket wall bars the way.
voidheart.page.klein_star:  to open a star on the end of the staff. It grows there for 2 seconds, going where you turn the staff, while its arcs lash the ground and it tears crumbs off the blocks around it. Holding the staff shows where a star would burst, and while one grows you steer it by looking: what you look at counts many times over. What it saw while it grew it follows even behind walls, going around them. Then it curves its way to the strongest enemy it can see, settles between those around it and bursts. The blast reaches 6 blocks and passes every shield, a Shielding Apparatus included. All it reaches is left Radiant, burning for 8 seconds, and the blocks facing the burst stay lit for 10 seconds and burn whatever comes within a block of them. It spares no one: stand back, and stay off the lit ground. Each star burns 500 Contravoid of the 4,000 it holds.  a Ravenous Storage holding Contravoid to fill it.
voidheart.page.armillary_core: Set in the middle of a square of cut ravenous gold with chiseled voidstone at its corners, with the three layers above left free, it raises three rings that feel their way down to broken worlds. Reach for a bubble on its map and open it with void pearls. Use the tear between the rings to cross and the rift at the far end to come back, before the connection gives way.
voidheart.page.beholder: A floating eye that watches the land around it for your {{oculus_table}}s, and keeps its own chunk loaded so that what stands near it stays in sight. Its tables come from [[far_sight]].
voidheart.jade.void_fissure.width: Width %s: the network takes %s VE a tick
voidheart.jade.void_wound.dead: Gives nothing, and seeps all the same
voidheart.void_fissure.needs: Tearing it to width %s takes a %s
voidheart.void_fissure.widest: It is torn as wide as it will go
voidheart.void_fissure.wound_widen: A wound has nothing left to give
voidheart.page.fissure_seed: Set on firm ground, it tears open a Void Fissure: a crack into the void that bleeds void energy into the field of an {{azurium_pylon}}, 16 a tick at first. An azurium bundle pressed into the crack tears it wider, four times at most, for up to 88 a tick: a small bundle twice, then a medium, then a large. What seeps out spreads a block a minute, farther the wider it is torn. Inside it wards weaken, corruption creeps up on whoever stands there, and weak void creatures come through. Close to a ley line, it taints the line's node. Nothing breaks it. Only Contravoid poured in through Ravenous Relays closes it again, 2,000 for each width.
voidheart.rei.fissure_seed.open: Set on firm ground, it tears open a Void Fissure that bleeds %s VE a tick into an azurium pylon's field.
voidheart.rei.fissure_seed.widen: An azurium bundle tears it wider: a small one to widths 2 and 3, a medium to 4 and a large to 5, for up to %s VE a tick.
voidheart.rei.fissure_seed.seep: Its seep spreads a block a minute, up to %s blocks at the widest. Inside it wards weaken, corruption rises and weak void creatures come through.
voidheart.rei.fissure_seed.close: Nothing breaks it. A Ravenous Relay pouring in Contravoid closes it, %s for each width.
voidheart.rei.azurium_pylon.field: Set an azurium bundle in its claws and it holds a field of void energy around the bundle: %s blocks for a small bundle, %s for a medium and %s for a large.
voidheart.rei.azurium_pylon.cap: A field passes up to %s, %s or %s VE a tick. Machines inside it draw from it with no wiring, and sources inside it give into it.
voidheart.rei.azurium_pylon.arc: Pylons whose fields reach each other in plain sight arc, and pass energy down the chain without losing any.
voidheart.rei.rubrum_construct_core.buil: Where void energy is kept. Raise Construct Frames along the edges of a cube 3 or 5 blocks wide, and set the core in its middle.
voidheart.rei.rubrum_construct_core.bund: Each rubrum bundle in its sockets holds %s, %s or %s VE by its size, and each azurium bundle lets it fill and give back %s, %s or %s VE a tick more.
voidheart.rei.rubrum_construct_core.fiel: Inside the field of an Azurium Pylon it takes what machines leave over, and gives it back when they need more. Broken, it keeps its charge.
voidheart.rei.rubrum_construct_core.bud: Held above %s%% for %s hours, it grows a new small rubrum bundle.
voidheart.rei.rubrum_construct_frame.edg: The edges of a Rubrum Construct's cube, 3 or 5 blocks wide, with the construct at its middle.
voidheart.rei.rubrum_construct_frame.soc: The open faces between them are its sockets.  the construct with a rubrum or azurium bundle to set it in the free socket nearest your hand, and sneak and  with an empty hand to take the nearest one out.
voidheart.rei.cell_socket.use: Holds a Rubrum Cell. Inside the field of an Azurium Pylon it empties the cell into the field, up to %s VE a tick, or fills it from the field while it has a redstone signal.
voidheart.rei.rubrum_cell.use: Carries %s VE to where no pylon reaches. A Cell Socket fills it and empties it.
voidheart.rei.ley_stone.spur: Bends ley off a line toward you. A Standing Stone within %s blocks of a ley line taps it, and each stone as close to a connected one carries the spur on.
voidheart.rei.ley_stone.supply: Machines within %s blocks of a connected stone draw on the line.
voidheart.rei.ley_stone.share: Everything drawing on one line shares its flow, and what is upstream is served first. The flow rises and falls with the moon.
voidheart.rei.ley_ward.slow: Near a connected Standing Stone, it slows how fast corruption rises in anyone within %s blocks, down to %s%% of its pace at full strength. It never lowers what is already there.
voidheart.rei.ley_ward.weaken: It asks for %s ley, and holds the air less well on a weak supply, on a tainted line, or in the seep of the void.
voidheart.rei.ley_grower.grow: Near a connected Standing Stone, it makes the crops and saplings in a %s by %s square around it grow up to %s times as fast.
voidheart.rei.ley_grower.supply: It asks for %s ley, and helps only as far as its supply allows.
voidheart.rei.ravenous_engine.burn: Burns essence into void energy for the field of an Azurium Pylon around it. Ravenous Relays link to it and fill one tank each of Stillness, Fiery and Suffering essence, %s each.
voidheart.rei.ravenous_engine.rates: Stillness gives %s VE a tick, slow and steady. Fiery gives %s and burns fastest. Suffering gives %s, the most for each drop.
voidheart.rei.ravenous_engine.waste: It only burns while something draws from the field or has room to store, so nothing goes to waste.
voidheart.rei.azurium_spike.bleed: Driven into a ley line or node, it bleeds the ley into void energy for the field of an Azurium Pylon around it: %s VE a tick for each ley, up to %s ley.
voidheart.rei.azurium_spike.share:  it with an empty hand to bleed a larger share of the flow, 25, 50, 75 or all of it, and sneak to bleed less. It only bleeds what the field takes.
voidheart.rei.azurium_spike.taint: A quarter of the flow is less than the land heals. More taints the node, the taint runs downstream, and the node's flow weakens.
voidheart.rei.azurium_spike.contravoid: From a tainted node comes Contravoid, more the deeper the taint, for Ravenous Collectors within %s blocks attuned with an azurium shard.
voidheart.rei.contravoid_reactor_core.bu: Cancels Contravoid against Stillness, Fiery or Suffering essence, one of each together, for up to %s, %s or %s VE a tick: more than one Azurium Pylon can carry.
voidheart.rei.contravoid_reactor_core.li: Close it in Reactor Containment with a Reactor Intake at the middle of two opposite sides, then  it with an empty hand to light it, which draws %s VE from the field. Lit, it burns what the field takes, and never less than %s%% of its fullest burn.
voidheart.rei.contravoid_reactor_core.fa: If an intake runs dry or the containment is broken while it burns, it warns for %s seconds, then fails inward: it leaves a void wound where the core stood, taints the nearest ley node and loses its fuel.
voidheart.rei.contravoid_reactor_core.sh: A redstone signal on any of its blocks shuts it down safely, even while it warns.
voidheart.rei.contravoid_reactor_core.wo: The wound seeps like a fissure and gives nothing. Ravenous Relays still linked to the intakes pour their Contravoid into it, and close it once %s is paid.
voidheart.rei.reactor_containment.shell: The shell of a Contravoid Reactor: a cube 3 blocks wide around the core, with a Reactor Intake at the middle of two opposite sides. Once whole, the middle of each other side opens a narrow slit onto the light within.
voidheart.rei.reactor_containment.breach: Breaking any of it while the reactor burns starts the warning, and setting it back in time ends it.

voidheart.page.contravoid_reactor_core: Cancels Contravoid against an essence of the void, and gives enough void energy for a whole base: up to 400 VE a tick with Fiery, 320 with Stillness and 500 with Suffering, more than one {{azurium_pylon}} can carry. Close it in a cube of {{reactor_containment}} with a {{reactor_intake}} at the middle of two opposite sides, then  it with an empty hand to light it, which draws 200,000 VE from the field around it. Lit, it burns what the field takes, and never less than a quarter of its fullest burn. If an intake runs dry or the containment is broken while it burns, it warns for 45 seconds, then fails inward: it leaves a void wound where the core stood, taints the nearest ley node and loses its fuel. A redstone signal on any of its blocks shuts it down safely, even while it warns.
voidheart.page.reactor_containment: The shell of a {{contravoid_reactor_core}}: a cube 3 blocks wide around the core, with an intake at the middle of two opposite sides. Once whole, the middle of each other side opens a narrow slit onto the light within. Breaking any of it while the reactor burns starts the warning, and setting it back in time ends it.
voidheart.page.reactor_intake: Where Ravenous Relays deliver a {{contravoid_reactor_core}}'s fuel: Contravoid at one end, and Stillness, Fiery or Suffering essence at the other, one of each burned together. Each holds 4,000, and an empty one only takes what the other end lacks. Broken, it keeps its fuel.

research.voidheart.warding_lattice.desc: A worn shield that takes blows before armor does, shaped by the pieces set in its grid.
research.voidheart.layered_wards.desc: Wider lattices, wards against fire, arrows, blasts and magic, and cores that answer when the shield breaks. Builds on [[warding_lattice]].
voidheart.page.lesser_shielding_apparatu: Worn in its own slot, it holds a shield that takes blows after armor and before health, then refills a while after the last one. Use it in hand to open its 3x3 grid and set components in it like pieces of a puzzle. Falls, drowning, hunger and the void go through it. Raised on the altar into a {{greater_shielding_apparatus}}, it keeps its components.
voidheart.page.greater_shielding_apparat: A 4x4 grid around a stronger shield that refills sooner and faster. Raised from a {{lesser_shielding_apparatus}}, it keeps the components set in it.
voidheart.page.supreme_shielding_apparat: A 5x5 grid around the strongest shield, back the soonest after a blow. Raised from a {{greater_shielding_apparatus}}, it keeps the components set in it.
voidheart.page.apparatus_cell: The smallest piece of a shielding apparatus, a single cell that adds a little to its shield. It fills the gaps larger pieces leave.
voidheart.page.apparatus_bank: A line of three cells that adds more to the shield than three {{apparatus_cell}}s would.
voidheart.page.apparatus_reservoir: A square of four cells, the most shield for its space, and the hardest to fit beside other pieces.
voidheart.page.apparatus_resonator: A corner of three cells that makes the shield refill faster.
voidheart.page.apparatus_choir: Four cells in a T that make the shield refill much faster.
voidheart.page.apparatus_quickener: Two cells that shorten the wait between a blow and the shield refilling.
voidheart.page.apparatus_hastener: Four cells in a step that shorten the wait before refilling a good deal more.
voidheart.page.apparatus_ember_ward: Fire, lava and burning cost the shield half what they would.
voidheart.page.apparatus_arrow_ward: Arrows and other projectiles cost the shield half what they would.
voidheart.page.apparatus_blast_ward: Explosions cost the shield half what they would.
voidheart.page.apparatus_arcane_ward: Magic, from void orbs and arcane bolts to a Bishop's lance, costs the shield half what it would.
voidheart.page.apparatus_pulse_core: When the shield breaks, the monsters standing close are hurt and thrown back. An apparatus holds a single core.
voidheart.page.apparatus_blink_core: When the shield breaks, it steps you away from the blow and hides you for a moment. An apparatus holds a single core.
voidheart.page.apparatus_stasis_core: When the shield breaks, the monsters around you are slowed and weakened for a few seconds. An apparatus holds a single core.
voidheart.page.apparatus_mending_core: When the shield breaks, it heals you a little. An apparatus holds a single core.
